selection: One carryover acceptance plus five remaining original families; infrastructure and repairs are uncounted.

features.name: member_extensions
features.scope: Carryover acceptance of distinct dispatch/extension receivers and computed extension properties; not another new implementation.
restrictions: Source named companions, interface extensions, method-generic setters and generic/inferred/annotated source extension properties remain bounded.

features.name: expanded_enums
features.scope: Entry subclasses, abstract/open methods, interface dispatch/properties, constructor defaults/named arguments, initialization and exceptions, JVM signatures and Kotlin metadata.
restrictions: Abstract enum properties, secondary enum constructors and nested entry declarations remain unsupported.
Enum string interpolation is not included. No whole DevotionActivity or full-app pass is claimed.

features.name: value_classes
features.scope: Nongeneric single-field Int/Long/String/nullable-String value classes with nullable/generic/interface boxing, ordinary class/data-class consumption, mangled physical JVM ABI, metadata and Kotlin consumers.
restrictions: Generic/nested value declarations, other carrier types, secondary/default/explicit constructor visibility, companions, parameterized supertypes and decorated/inline/generic/vararg member shapes remain excluded.

Source object/interface/companion signatures and physical carrier calls, enum value storage/signatures/physical calls, and inner/enum/defaulted/secondary value-consuming constructors remain explicit boundaries. Direct boxed construction/property reads in five contexts are independently verified.

None of the five selected upstream originals passes in full: three language boundaries and two harness boundaries. Unchanged AndroidBible Gid/Rpp and independent authored proofs are separate evidence.
Internal temporaries are boxed; no optimization or complete app claim.

features.name: inner_classes
features.scope: Named final inner classes in nongeneric outer classes, enclosing identity/state, initialization, private outer access, source/compiled qualified constructors and bounded constructor references, JVM signatures and Kotlin metadata.
restrictions: Local classes, generic/chained inner classes or generic outer classes, open/abstract inner classes, secondary/default/annotated constructors and enum outers remain explicitly unsupported.
Complete related outer/inner class sets are swapped as providers. Synthetic private-access helper names/visibility may differ; public consumer ABI is checked and raw all-member output retained.
No unchanged whole AndroidBible file or full-app pass is claimed.

features.name: unsigned_values
features.scope: Bounded UInt/ULong scalar semantics through real JVM representation.
restrictions: Implementation and acceptance are in progress; no validated-family count yet.

features.name: suspend_foundation
features.scope: Nongeneric top-level suspend functions with straight-line bodies and ordinary primitive/reference values, suspend function parameters, real ContinuationImpl state and up to eight sequential suspension points; delayed resumption, saved state, ordinary source/compiled top-level suspend calls, exception identity, JVM ABI and logical Kotlin metadata.
restrictions: Source suspend lambdas/references/conversions, member/extension/generic/defaulted/vararg/inline suspend declarations and receiver suspend types remain unsupported.

Suspension in nested control flow, arguments or expression trees and imported suspend inline/default/member calls remain unsupported. Suspend function types allow at most 21 parameters. Nullable Unit, Unit-valued suspend callback inputs and value-class types anywhere in suspend IR are explicit boundaries.

Both WITH_COROUTINES upstream originals retain complete unchanged helper sources compiled by each provider and stop at the helper anonymous-object prerequisite. Source generic Result and complete coroutine-library compatibility remain unclaimed.

The one passing upstream original executes box without invoking its suspend function; it establishes its tested source/ABI contracts. Authored continuation and capacity fixtures establish real delayed execution.
Generated frame names, spill layouts, DebugMetadata, debugger and stacktrace equivalence are unassessed. No unchanged whole AndroidBible file, full-app or performance claim.

capacity_validation.eight_points: Same official-compiled Java caller verifies eight immediate callbacks and eight delayed resumptions against both providers with -Xverify:all, exact input/trace/result and completion count assertions.
capacity_validation.nine_points: Oracle-valid source rejects explicitly with SUSPEND_STATE_MACHINE_SHAPE_UNSUPPORTED and the eight-point-limit message.
capacity_validation.scope: Additional assertions for the existing family; no extra feature count.

integration_validation.clippy: Release all targets with warnings denied passed
integration_validation.value_interaction: An ordinary valueNeighbor function executes beside suspend declarations. Three actual loaded-value-class declaration/callback/saved-local boundaries reject explicitly.

limitations: Final combined validation is pending. Supported labels refer to bounded feature acceptance, not unrestricted Kotlin or Android compatibility.
